metadata.description: Axiom Agent · Azure Reader role assignment. Grants the platform's service principal the built-in Reader role over the selected subscription so the scanner can do inventory + posture analysis. Pure ARM template — no resources are created, only a role assignment is bound.
Object ID of the VisionXIXLabs service principal in your Azure AD tenant. Get this value from visionxixlabs.com/operator/onboarding after picking Azure.

properties.description: Read-only Reader role for Axiom Agent (VisionXIXLabs).
